definitions.gloss: commitment to quality; attention to detail; dedication to something
definitions.explanation: a positive sense of being particular or meticulous about something, showing care and dedication

definitions.gloss: fixation; obsession; being hung up on something
definitions.explanation: being overly attached to or unable to let go of something, sometimes with negative connotations

notes:
FORMS:
⟦こだわる→こだわる：10319_kodawaru⟧ (to be particular about; to be obsessed with)

SEMANTIC SHIFT:
Originally, ⟦こだわる→こだわる：10319_kodawaru⟧ had mainly negative connotations (being hung up on something). In modern usage, it has developed a positive meaning of "being dedicated to quality" or "attention to detail," especially in business and food contexts.

COMMON PATTERNS:
- ～⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧こだわり⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦ある→ある：00006_aru⟧ (to be particular about ~)
- ～⟦へ→へ：02473_he⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧こだわり (commitment to ~)
- こだわり⟦の→の：09472_no⟧～ (carefully selected/crafted ~)

MARKETING USE:
こだわり is commonly used in marketing and advertising:
- こだわり⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{食材|しょくざい}→食材：04940_shokuzai⟧ (carefully selected ingredients)
- こだわり⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{一杯|いっぱい}→一杯：01793_ippai⟧ (a carefully crafted drink)
- こだわり⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{逸品|いっぴん}→逸品：19463_ippin⟧ (a quality item made with care)

NOTE ON NUANCE:
- Positive: shows dedication, craftsmanship, quality
- Negative: suggests inflexibility, being picky, inability to let go
